column1: # Where curated subtitles come from, per conference folder.
# Used by: scripts/deploy-confs.sh subtitles   (node scripts/confs.mjs sync-subtitles)
# Only .srt files referenced by that conference's index.json are copied
# Source trees are searched recursively by basename. Gallery names may add a
# session prefix (morning-|lunch-|afternoon-) that is stripped when matching
# speaker-cut files in the subtitles repo (SEDI).
# Conferences without a line here keep the .srt files that are already in place.
